label: Mouse move
description: Animate as the mouse moves over the element.

label: While scrolling
description: Tracks the visibility of an element as it enters and exits the viewport.

label: Accordion item change
description: Animate when the accordion item opens or closes.

label: Dropdown change
description: Animate when the dropdown opens or closes.

label: Scroll into view
description: Animate when the element enters viewport.

label: Form submit
description: Runs when the form reaches a submission outcome.

label: Hover
description: Animate when the cursor hovers the element.

label: Page load
description: Activates when the page finishes loading.

label: Scroll direction change
description: Animate when the scroll direction changes.

label: Slide change
description: Animate when the slide slides in or out.

label: Tab change
description: Animate when the tab becomes active or inactive.
